text:
mara_cs: kicking off dedicated pool commissioning for Harbinger today. main goals: quota alignment, autoscale validation, chaos/load run. pinging eng + sre for windows and rollback play.

jason_runtime: on it. i've uploaded the initial quota spreadsheet to the shared drive — link: https://drive.redwood/harbinger/quota-v1

linda_sre: thanks. quick ask: what's target steady qps and peak burst? that'll drive autoscale thresholds.

mara_cs: steady = 120 qps, sustained peak = 400 qps for 10m, burst windows up to 900 qps for <2m. need 99th percentile tail latency < 350ms. note: customer wants KV cache warmup before full ramp.

jason_runtime: noted. plan to serve two model variants: full (fp16 quant) and lightweight fallback (int8-opt). routing policy will prefer full, fallback at 85% CPU/GPU util.

omar_oncall: i drafted canary schedule: 5% traffic @ 2m -> 20% @ 10m -> 50% @ 30m -> 100% @ 1h if no regressions. instrumentation hooks on each step.

linda_sre: autoscale config i recommend:
- scale up when avg GPU util > 60% for 45s
- add 2 nodes per increment
- scale down after util < 35% for 5m
also set safety cap at 12 nodes for this pool.

mara_cs: sounds good. we need a pre-run checklist for customer enablement call:
- confirm quota applied in console
- shared warmup script executed
- failover route to hosted smallmodel
- alerting thresholds (latency/cost/err rate)
- schedule post-run retro with customer

jason_runtime: warmup script (run from infra box):
```
./prefix_warmup.sh --target http://dedicated.harbg.internal --tokens 100000 --concurrency 8
```
it primes KV cache and populates common prompt prefixes. run ~30m before canary.

deploy-bot: deploy-started: dedicated-service/harbinger-pool v1.3 -> nodes: 4

omar_oncall: we'll inject a small chaos test mid-ramp (15m) to validate fallback: simulate a single-node OOM and ensure routing falls back to hosted variant within 30s.

linda_sre: add to checklist: verify circuit-breaker opens after 5% error rate for >30s and that retries use exponential backoff.

mara_cs: customer enablement: @harbinger-eng lead will be on call at +1 if we hit thresholds. also capturing feedback template below for post-run:
- perceived latency vs expectation
- any tokenization/response truncation issues
- cost delta for peak period
- suggestions on prewarm timing

jason_runtime: load test plan (high level):
1) prefix warmup 30m
2) smoke 5% canary 2m
3) ramp to 50% over 30m with steady-state probes
4) inject chaos (single-node failure)
5) burst tests: 900 qps x 90s x 3 intervals
6) cooldown and analyze traces

omar_oncall: i'll own alerts and oncall rotation. linda will watch infra metrics. jason take runtime telemetry. mara please coordinate customer-facing comms.

mara_cs: assigned. final question: any cost limit guard to stop ramp? we should set a budget cutoff.

linda_sre: put a soft budget cutoff at $3.2k/hr for the pool; if exceeded, autopause ramp and notify #billing.

jason_runtime: ack. i'll add an automated abort if spend > budget or 95th latency > 600ms.

mara_cs: perfect. i'll run the enablement call at 09:30 PT and start warmup at 09:00 PT. post-run retro at 14:00 PT. thanks all :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: deploy-complete: dedicated-service/harbinger-pool v1.3 -> nodes: 6

omar_oncall: all monitors green after canary. started ramp to 20%. ongoing updates in thread.

mara_cs: excellent — please paste short notes here during the ramp. we'll use them in the customer report.

jason_runtime: note: observed KV hit rate 87% after 20m warmup. 99th p95 latency 320ms at 50% ramp. captured traces at /traces/harbinger/2468642000

linda_sre: saw a small spike in tail latency during first burst; tracing suggests a hot shard on node-3, rebalanced successfully. no user-visible errors.

mara_cs: logged. thanks team — we'll proceed with the scheduled chaos test at +45m. I'll message the customer about expected short degradation window.

omar_oncall: chaos injected. fallback engaged for 18s, no loss of requests. reopening ramp.

mara_cs: post-run quick notes for retro:
- warmup timing OK
- autoscale thresholds tuned right
- fallback fast enough
- need better shard balancing pre-burst (action: jason)

jason_runtime: taking action item to add shard-aware placement and a pre-burst rebalance job.

mara_cs: closing thread, will post full report and customer feedback form later today.
